anchor.note: diagnostic anchor only; not claimed as a tuned optimum (LR_RANGE_UNRESOLVED lineage preserved)

batches.rule: production stream seed-2030 p=0.5 continued after step 2048; windows_per_step=128 (64A+64B), micro_batch=32, accum=4; first5/last5 window sets disjoint (verified)

gradient_collection.forward: production bf16 autocast, model.eval-equivalent frozen params fp32, dropout=0
gradient_collection.loss: per-micro mean CE over valid targets, backward (loss/4); 4 micro per batch
gradient_collection.clip: global norm over ALL grad-bearing unique params (Muon+AdamW aux), max_norm=1.0, after accumulation; per-matrix G saved POST-clip

H_construction.per_batch_independent: M_i = lerp(M_*, G_i, 1-beta); H_i = lerp(G_i, M_i, beta); NOT propagated across batches
H_construction.H_ref: mean of first-5 H in fp64, then cast back to fp32 (single conversion); frozen in calibration_lock.json before check-half analysis

three_paths.input: one captured fp32 H_in, cloned to each path
three_paths.fp64: same tensor .double(), installed-semantics finite NS (clamp eps 1e-7, coeff, 5 steps)
three_paths.fp32: same tensor fp32 NS, TF32 disabled during diagnostics
three_paths.shape_rule: transpose only if rows>cols (none of the six matrices trigger)
three_paths.D_raw: raw NS output; no LR/WD/shape factor; s(r,c)=sqrt(max(1,A/B)) logged separately per matrix

diagnostics.natural: all 10 H_i through all three paths; rel offset ||H_i-H_ref||/||H_ref||
diagnostics.alpha_def: H_in = H_ref + alpha*(H_i - H_ref) in fp32; alpha=+1 forced to the SAVED original H_i; actual relative perturbation recorded per row
diagnostics.jvp: L = J_FP64(H_ref)[H_in.double() - H_ref.double] via E2 tangent recursion (directional, no full Jacobian)
diagnostics.repetition: H_ref, batch1, batch6 natural H re-mapped once through all paths (determinism check)
